oggetto.testo: GymMaster is a web platform for managing gym workouts that allows users to create and follow workout plans, track their progress, communicate with other users and interact with personal trainers.

registrazione.datiVeritieri: To use the service you must create an account by providing truthful and up-to-date information.
registrazione.personale: The account is personal and non-transferable.
registrazione.approvazione: Registration is subject to approval by the administrator.
registrazione.credenziali: The user is responsible for the security of their login credentials.
registrazione.eta: The user must be at least 16 years old to register (pursuant to Art. 8 GDPR).

obblighi.lecito: Use the service lawfully and in accordance with these terms
obblighi.contenuti: Not share offensive, illegal or inappropriate content
obblighi.accessi: Not attempt to access the accounts or data of other users
obblighi.automatismi: Not use unauthorised bots, scripts or automated tools
obblighi.sicurezza: Not circumvent the application's security measures

personalTrainer.ruolo: Users can request the Personal Trainer role, subject to approval.
personalTrainer.attivita: Personal Trainers can create exercises, manage clients and schedule appointments.
personalTrainer.qualifiche: GymMaster does not verify the professional qualifications of Personal Trainers and accepts no responsibility for their services.
personalTrainer.responsabilita: A user who signs up with a Personal Trainer does so at their own responsibility.

proprietaIntellettuale.testo: GymMaster is an open-source project. The source code is available on <link>GitHub</link>. Content created by users (plans, custom exercises) remains the property of its respective authors.

disclaimerMedico.testo: GymMaster does not provide medical advice. The application is a workout tracking tool and does not replace the advice of a doctor or healthcare professional. Always consult a doctor before starting a new workout programme.

responsabilita.intro: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. The owner is not liable for:
responsabilita.perditaDati: Data loss due to force majeure
responsabilita.usoImproprio: Damage resulting from improper use of the application
responsabilita.infortuni: Injuries or physical harm resulting from workouts

sospensione.ban: The administrator may suspend or ban accounts that violate these terms.
sospensione.cancellazione: The user may request the deletion of their account and related data at any time.

modifiche.testo: We reserve the right to modify these terms. Changes will be communicated through the application. Continued use of the service after notification constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

leggeApplicabile.testo: These terms are governed by European Union law, in particular Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). For any dispute, the court of the place of residence of the consumer user shall have jurisdiction, in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1215/2012.
